en: A historical black and white postcard depicting a large street procession watched by crowds on both sides. The scene shows people dressed in medieval or Renaissance costumes, many on horseback, parading through a city street. The style of dress of both the participants and onlookers suggests an early 20th-century event commemorating a much older tradition. Visible French text at the bottom references Bruges, an important historical city, and mentions a festivity (Pas de l'Arbre d'Or 1468) held in July 1907.
